description: This file defines a CMake function 'compile_aidl' used for generating source code from AIDL files during build time. It handles locating the 'aidl' compiler, setting appropriate flags based on parameters, and executing the compilation command. The code includes documentation describing its purpose and usage conventions.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code with customizable options such as language, include directories, and target output directory.
